data.title: The Woodland Residences
data.about:
Take a look at The Woodland Residences by Amis at Dubailand, a signature project of Amis Properties. This remarkable development in the heart of Meydan District 11 offers an exclusive collection of thirty 5-bedroom villas.

The Woodland Residences Villas are a masterpiece of design, embodying the luxury and innovation synonymous with the Lamborghini brand. The Woodland Residences community is an oasis of lush greenery, providing breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa skyline. 

Experience the pinnacle of luxurious living at Woodland Residences Meydan, where each home is a harmonious blend of elegance and advanced technology, featuring a unique temperature-controlled lazy river, redefining the essence of upscale living.

characteristics_module.title: A Rare Collection of Exquisite Villas in Meydan
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exclusive Design: Villas feature Automobili Lamborghini surfaces, showcasing luxury and sophistication.
  • Limited Availability: Only 30 three-storey, five-bedroom villas in this unique AMIS Properties and Lamborghini collaboration.
  • Spacious Interiors: Each villa offers terraces, 13-ft high ceilings, and starts at 7,300 ft² for maximum comfort.
  • Luxury Amenities: Equipped with German appliances, designer interiors, rooftop pool, and staff accommodations.
  • Community Features: Children's playgrounds, playrooms, relaxation zones, and a resident-exclusive lagoon.
  • Avant-Garde Style: A blend of AMIS Properties' expert development and Lamborghini's exclusive design.
  • Prime Location: Situated in Meydan, Dubai, known for luxury, the Meydan Racecourse, and expansive green spaces.

location_tile.title: Discover Woodland Residences in Meydan
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
The prestigious Woodland Residences location in Meydan exemplifies a blend of opulence and sophistication, a hallmark of The Woodland Residences by Amis. This vast area, part of The Woodland Residences at Dubailand, offers a unique lifestyle that combines urban luxury with a tranquil environment. A notable highlight of Meydan, and by extension of Woodland Residences, is the renowned Meydan Racecourse, host of the Dubai World Cup. This feature adds to the allure of 'Woodland Residences Meydan, offering residents of The Woodland Residences Villas a chance to experience the thrill of world-class horse racing events in their immediate vicinity.

  • 10 minutes from Downtown Dubai
  • 15 minutes from Dubai International Airport
